facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 77°F at pass elevation.
No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 28.

facts.text: Snow left Bigelow Camp (5,130 ft) and Big Red Mountain (6,060 ft) 27 to 39 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Bigelow Camp
evidence.detail: left April 3; earlier seasons: May 18 (2023), April 23 (2024), April 30 (2025)

evidence.name: Big Red Mountain
evidence.detail: left April 24; earlier seasons: June 5 (2023), May 28 (2024), June 2 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Bigelow Camp (5,130 ft) and Big Red Mountain (6,060 ft).

evidence.name: Bigelow Camp
evidence.detail: 1.2 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 32.7 in (2023), 15.0 in (2024), 27.4 in (2025)

evidence.name: Big Red Mountain
evidence.detail: 1.6 in on April 3; earlier seasons: 35.9 in (2023), 21.8 in (2024), 31.9 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between January 17 and April 3, carried from the melt-out date at Bigelow Camp (5,130 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Bigelow Camp
evidence.detail: melted out April 3, 2,167 ft above the pass; points to January 17 to April 3
